name: Multigrain Cookies
ingredients_raw: Cereal Products (45%) (Refined Wheat Flour (Maida), Rice, Ragi, Oats, Corn), Sweetener (INS 965 - Maltitol), Edible Vegetable Oil (Palm), Oat Fibre, Nuts (4%) (Almond & Cashew), Butter, Desiccated Coconut Powder, Wheat Bran, Leavening Agents (INS 503 ii, INS 500 ii), Emulsifier (INS 322 from Soy), lodised Salt, Vitamins and Minerals, Nature Identical and Artificial Flavouring Substances (Vanillin).
